conclusions.text: Complete consumed COD and AGO simplified admin product bytes and all 350 features were retained and verified; overlays establish source geometry relationships only.
Natural Earth and 2021 WorldCover references do not determine dated physical-water status for any complete component; all ten current dispositions remain unresolved.
Cause and any repair authorization remain unknown; this packet makes no geometry proposal or ownership decision.
The included prior complete-family screen reports two unique-compatible and eight mixed/partial cases, but is retained as preceding context rather than independent water or causal evidence.
Merged #1215 successor lineage preserves ten exact component IDs and hashes; an unmerged later assessment is not treated as delivered.
